title: lamium montanum subsp. endtmannii
intro: Lamium montanum subsp. endtmannii, commonly known as Endt's Lamium, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family, Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cold, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Endt's Lamium include acting as an expectorant, antimicrobial, and antiseptic, which helps to relieve cough, congestion, and other respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
